<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/api/stories/{id}/pin"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



On a live story this just unpins it. On an expired Highlight there is
nothing to fall back to, so it **deletes** the story (`deleted: true`).
